scope.invariant: document-start installs page boundaries before launcher routing, the workbench executes only on expansion, one load/session is active, failed expansion permits retry, and explicit unmount cleans up or rejects late results.
scope.selectedChain: main.ts -> task/normal-document routing -> mountUserscriptLauncher -> first click -> bootstrap-userscript-app -> mountUserscriptApp and injected runtime -> explicit unmount or load failure.
allowedPaths: Direct configure/storage lifecycle excerpts, production entry configuration and matching tests
expansionReasons: Bootstrap and the mount adapter own completion/failure/unmount of the launcher promise; their boundary is required to verify the selected lifecycle.
configureUserscriptWorkbench and product-storage pagehide excerpts only identify runtime injection and the writer release owner. Their independent storage semantics remain B06/B11-gm-storage work.
The actual build audit and metadata establish eager execution and document-start/noframes; complete production-graph policy coverage remains a separate B11 candidate.
exclusions: Product implementation fixes or permanent tests
Shared App.vue hide/player/download behavior, Shadow DOM layout/focus and the independent B11-shadow-dom batch
Page-bridge validation/signing/capture internals and protected-page transport
GM HTTP/cookies/limits/single proxy and full product-generation storage audit
Tauri/native transport, full external-plugin entry rejection coverage, live Tampermonkey and browser/application inspection
Root final acceptance, commit and push

checks.question: Do document-start and expansion remain owned by the Userscript composition layer?
checks.limit: No independent shared-workbench or UI ownership audit.

checks.question: Are bridges/guard installed before routing, with product execution deferred until expansion?
checks.detail: Five routing probes pass, including a missing document root, fragment/session capture routing and denied sessionStorage. Production eager graph has 25 modules and no Vue, Pinia, product styles, workbench or bootstrap.

checks.question: Are loads single-flight, failures retryable and late results cleaned up after explicit disposal?
checks.detail: Seven launcher probes cover lazy/single-flight loading, cleared-root rejection retry, undefined-result retry, disposal before paint, late success, late rejection and external host removal. Existing bootstrap cases verify storage readiness and once-only release for explicit unmount/failure.
checks.limit: Injected module/DOM doubles do not establish browser/SystemJS failure caching, actual page-exit integration, hide behavior or renderer effects after partial Vue mount.

checks.question: Does this expansion entry inject the Userscript built-in-only policy without a native runtime?
checks.detail: The inspected configure boundary fixes externalPlugins to none; generated metadata preserves match *://*/*, noframes and document-start. The existing production guard rejects external executor/installer code and found no such rendered modules.
checks.limit: Full @grant/@connect inventory, every activation/command/media/prefetch entry and bridge authorization semantics remain separate unreviewed candidates.

checks.question: Are conclusions supported by current tests and actual artifacts, with live acceptance kept separate?
checks.detail: 80 existing package tests pass; the 34-case targeted group includes 12 temporary audit probes and 22 repeated existing tests. Typecheck and production build pass. Probe sources/logs remain local; only audit records are added to tracked paths.
